name: Scrap Runs
description: Help the scavenger secure salvage.|A local scavenger is overloaded and needs reliable hands to haul usable scrap from nearby ruins.

text: The outer ruins still have structural timber and scrap.
I'm burnt out from nonstop recovery trips.
Bring me 10 logs so I can reinforce camp walls.

hasItemText: Good haul, but we still need more material.
Bring another 10 logs and we're set.
completedText: Just 10 more logs and the barricade is done.

hasItemText: Perfect. This is exactly what we needed.
Take this salvaged axe and keep moving, Seeker.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Scrap Runs@green@ quest. You have received a @crimson@Rusted Axe@green@!
